entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mage cited as an example of a powerful, death-vulnerable mage who fights other mages.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker whose overrun ability is said to take much power and energy out of him.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who, the column says, would distract an opponent and escape rather than risk death.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker mage who could be squished by an elephant only if she lacked her wits and spells.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker used as an example when discussing loyalty versus a hidden life total.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker used as an example of a planeswalker's loyalty total.

entities.name: the Multiverse
entities.description: The collection of planes through which planeswalkers travel.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose name players initially mispronounced.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane whose elves name their nobility after degrees of flawlessness, with Perfects at the top.

events.summary: The column explains that planeswalkers risk their lives in magical duels, and may retreat rather than fight to the death.
events.quote: She distracts her opponent and gets the hell out of there

events.summary: The column describes planeswalkers as powerful, resourceful mages able to survive frontal assaults.
events.quote: They're resourceful, canny, spell-skilled, and battle-trained
